candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that credits msg.value to the sender's balance.
Replace the balance accumulation with an assignment that overwrites the balance with msg.value.
Replace the unlockTime assignment with the raw _unlockTime value (no clamping to block.timestamp).
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log.
Delete the `locked_ = false;` statement so the mutex never resets and every subsequent Put call reverts.
Delete the balance-decrement statement so Collect no longer reduces the caller's stored balance.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so successful Collects are no longer recorded in the log.
Send acc.balance instead of _am in the external call so the transferred value differs whenever _am < balance.
Remove the success check on the external call so the balance is decremented even when the call fails.
Delete the lock-release statement so the contract stays locked after the first guarded call, making subsequent Collect calls revert.
Move the lock-acquire statement after the function body so reentrancy protection is ineffective and the lock is left set after each call.
